title: Multigenerational exposure to nanomaterials induces transgenerational memory without detectable genetic alterations in Arabidopsis thaliana
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, 12,4980-4993
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00406C, Paper
Xiuli Jing, Yankai Liu, Yani Zhang, Xun Wang, Hanlin Niu, Wancong Li, Chun-Xiang You, Xiao-Fei Wang, Shuai Zhang
Multigenerational ENM exposure in Arabidopsis thaliana induced no detectable genomic alterations but triggered transgenerational inheritance of analogous growth memory phenotypes, offering new insights for sustainable agricultural nanotechnology.
